buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 50% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 50 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 50 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 50 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 3. Generic Buyer Organization specific Integrity Pact shall have to be complied by all bidders. Bidders shall have to upload scanned copy of signed integrity pact as per Buyer organizations policy along with bid. Click here to view the file 4. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Payment online through RTGS / internet banking in Beneficiary name Hindustan Petroleum Corporation Ltd Account No. 10404415390 IFSC Code SBIN0009930 Bank Name State Bank of India, Branch: Industrial Finance Branch Branch address 155, Anna Salai, Chennai - 600002, Tamil Nadu. Confirmation to be sent to jjayakarthik@hpcl.in . Bidder to indicate bid number and name of bidding entity in the transaction details field at the time of on- line transfer. Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the Online Payment Transfer along with bid. 5. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Bid for Mechanical and Electrical Maintenance and associated Services at HPCL Madurai LP G Plant (Address included in ATC). Any clarification on scope and other terms and conditions of the service maybe clarified wit h user/project team whose details are included in the ATC document. Bidders are advised read and thoroughly understand the bid including ATC and other requir ements and then submit their offers. All documents and declaration as per formats include d in the ATC to be submitted along with bid for appropriate evaluation. Specification accept ance/Compliance along with proposed Make and Model of supply item to be submitted alon g with bid for evaluation and acceptance.

Delivery address for each line shall be as per address in the ATC section. Overall L1 schedule wise as per GeM price bid format (i.e., landed rate) with single bidder p lacement shall be followed. Since bid is enabled with floor price, selection methodology un der different scenarios is as follows In case of Purchase Preference enablement due to L1(Non-MSE) & L2 (MSE) as per bid resul t, L2 shall be awarded the entire PO (as work is not splitable) subject to L1 price match acc eptance by L2(MSE) bidder. In case of multiple L2(MSE) bidders enabled for MSE preferenc e, then evaluation of all L1 price matched L2(MSE) bidders shall be as per weighted method mentioned in the next case. In case of more than one L1, MSE preference shall be applicable and MSE bidder shall be co nsidered for award of PO. In case of more than L1 in same category i.e., all L1 bidders are Non-MSE or all L1 bidders are MSE of both, then first all MSE L1 bidders shall be evaluated and in case of non-acceptance by all L1 MSE bidders then non-MSE bidders shall be evaluat ed. Following weighted methodology shall be used for evaluation and selection of PO award . · 70 % of PO value submitted and accepted in TE for qualification in Lakhs and 30% of Av erage Turnover Value in Lakhs shall be cumulated and the bidder with higher resulting weig hted value shall be awarded the PO. · Ex, If Bidder A & B are both L1 in same category and following are their PO & Turnover v alues then calculation as below shall be applied Bidder Qualified PO Value in Average Turnover Value i Weighted Value in Lak Lakh n Lakh h A 50 30 =50*(0.7) + 30*(0.3) = 44 B 30 54 =30*(0.7) + 54*(0.3) = 37.2 · Bidder A shall be selected for award as bidder A’s weighted value is higher. In case sam e weighted value is arrived for 2 or multiple bidders, then bidder with higher qualified PO v alue shall be selected for award for PO. · In case of scenario other than above or violation/falsification of information, HPCL reserv es the right to select at its discretion without assigning any reason and take action as neces sary as per the case inline with procurement policy. The default GST percentages as per GOI notifications shall be applicable to the individual li ne items, In case of any GST percentage change as per item description same to be include d in declaration as per formats included in ATC. In event of splitting due to MSE/MII or both

preference, total order shall be awarded to the MSE/MII party subject to acceptance of Price match L1 rate by the MSE/MII party. Auto verifications by GEM will be used for selection wherever available. Application of MSE/ MII preference as per actual status/condition of the bidder shall be the bidder's responsibilit y. Buyer shall not be held responsible nor entertain any preference documents if they are n ot suitably applied along with their bid submission. . 6.
